g.text: Entry points
Core
State
External
llama() shell alias · language as arg 1, defaults to fstab, execs chunk-reader
ollama run llama3 · the only producer, tokens plus an inter-turn prompt
your keyboard · raw bytes on the same stdin, 1 or 4 byte chunks
main loop · 1 KiB stdin reads, no goroutines, exits on EOF without flushing
mode machine · LLM or user chosen by chunk size, no protocol marker
accumulator · keeps every non-ESC chunk while the answer streams
flush branch · a chunk over 20 bytes is the prompt, so the answer ended
StripANSI · drops ESC plus everything up to the next letter
bat call · pipetty+batcat -ppP -lOL_LANG, whole answer, printed at once
post-chunk-reader.go · abandoned newline-stripping pass-through, not built by the README
llmMsg + llmMsg_size · RAM only, reset at every flush
built chunk-reader binaries · go build output, gitignored
OL_LANG · the only configuration, read once per finished answer
ollama server · model text, ANSI cursor codes, the >>> help prompt
batcat and its syntax set · needs whole text, no incremental highlight
pipetty from colorized-logs · fake tty so bat keeps colour into a pipe
